title: Marketplace APAC localization and partner credit playbook
content:
Purpose:
This working playbook outlines the operational checklist, copy snippets, and acceptance criteria for launching Redwood listings and partner credit offers in APAC cloud marketplaces (AWS Singapore, Azure Japan, GCP Seoul) and allied partner storefronts. The doc focuses on region-specific localization, currency & tax treatments, partner credit mechanics, and the minimal legal/billing artifacts required for go/no-go.

Context and scope (short):
- Goal: Produce a repeatable checklist and copy assets that let marketplace PMs and partner ops spin up APAC listings + partner trial credits within a 3-week runway.
- Scope: Listing metadata, tile & short copy variants (EN/JP/KO/EN-AU), pricing and SKU mapping, partner credit coupon design, billing/legal dependencies, and internal test matrix.
- Out of scope: Deep integration with on-prem/private deployments; refer to private-deployments playbook for any air-gapped compliance asks.

Key stakeholders:
- Owner: Asha Patel (go-to-market)
- Partner ops: Miguel Santos
- Localization lead: Hana Kim
- Pricing & billing: Priya Desai
- Legal & compliance: Liam O'Connor (consult)
- Engineering contact (marketplace infra): @eng-marketplace (linked in Slack channel)

Rollout principles (constraints we follow):
1) Minimal viable listing first: ship English + locale-specific price/currency + partner credit SKU. Add translations in a second sprint if acceptance gates allow.
2) Keep copy variants short (tile 1 line, short blurb 1–2 sentences, 3 bullets of product value).
3) Partner credit mechanics should be auditable and non-reversible: coupon SKUs must map to a ledger entry (billing) and a partner id.
4) Where regional law demands local data residency disclosures, include a short legal line on the tile and link to the compliance page.

Acceptance checklist (preflight):
- Content / Copy:
  - Tile headline (EN) drafted and validated with partner comms.
  - Short blurb (70–120 chars) crafted for mobile tiles.
  - Three benefit bullets (max 100 chars each) focused on latency, cost control, and deployment modes.
  - Call to action: "Try free with partner credits" (translated variants below).
- Localization:
  - Currency mapping: SGD / JPY / KRW / AUD configured and validated in pricing sheet.
  - Time zone and support hours listed for APAC region (UTC+8/9/10 ranges).
  - Translation pass #1 (machine + human spot check): JP, KO, and AU-EN copy.
  - Date formatting & punctuation localized (e.g., JP full-width characters not used on tiles).
- Technical & billing: 
  - SKU created for partner credit coupon: format PRT-APAC-<partner>-<amount>-YYYYMM.
  - Billing test: coupon redemption reduces billed usage and generates partner ledger entry (test case ID: BILL-APAC-01).
  - Metering mapping: Embeddings vs generation units explicitly mapped to marketplace units.
  - Legal tax note: VAT/GST treatment documented for each target jurisdiction and included in listing.
- Compliance & data residency:
  - If private-deployment option is shown, include one-line disclosure: "Private deployment available — contact sales for VPC/on-prem details."
  - PII processing statement: short copy linked to privacy page localized for region.
- Ops readiness:
  - Support SLA mapping: show support tier and response window for partner-managed trials.
  - Rollback plan: listing archival checklist and partner credit revocation steps documented.

Partner credit design (mechanics):
- Typical offer patterns to propose:
  - Flat credit: e.g., "USD-equivalent 2,000 credit" mapped to local currency at launch day FX. Good for universal trials.
  - Usage-based coupon: e.g., "100,000 token equivalent" for token-metered trials; useful if partner prefers usage ceilings.
  - Time-limited access: credits + 30-day time window.
- Redemption flow (end-user experience):
  1) User selects listing > clicks CTA "Get partner credits"
  2) Marketplace redirects to Redwood partner flow -> creates trial account (or links existing account).
  3) Coupon applied automatically in billing profile, visible on account billing page and in the marketplace invoice.
- Security & anti-fraud notes:
  - Limit one coupon per Redwood account/email/organization for partner initial offers.
  - Partner ops to provide a partner whitelist for early pilots; blacklist abusive accounts.

Copy snippets (short tile variants) — EN / JA / KO / AU-EN
- Headline EN: "Low-latency LLM inference for product teams — start with partner credits"
- Short blurb EN: "Production-grade inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Get partner credits to try at scale."
- Bullet 1 EN: "Sub-100ms median latency available in APAC zones"
- Bullet 2 EN: "Predictable pricing via dedicated pools and autoscaling"
- Bullet 3 EN: "Evals & quality monitoring to avoid regressions"

- Headline JP (draft literal): "APAC向けの低遅延LLM推論 — パートナークレジットで開始"
- Short blurb JP (draft): "ホステッド/専用/プライベートで一貫した推論性能。スケールで試すためのクレジットを提供。"

- Headline KO (draft literal): "APAC 저지연 LLM 추론 — 파트너 크레딧으로 시작하세요"
- Short blurb KO (draft): "호스티드·전용·프라이빗에서 일관된 추론 성능. 평가용 크레딧 제공."

- Headline AU-EN (locale tone): "High-performance LLM inference — claim partner credits"

Notes on translation approach:
- Use human review for headline and CTA only. Bullets can be machine-first + spot check.
- Avoid literal "LLM" in JP/KO tiles if partner marketing prefers local term; maintain alignment with partner brand voice.

Marketplace-specific acceptance details:
- AWS Singapore (ap-southeast-1):
  - Require AWS listing tile copy + 1-sentence capability line.
  - Must attach an AWS-ready security FAQ (1 page).
  - Partner credit SKU must be created in our internal billing system and referenced in AWS listing as "promotional code" flow.
- Azure Japan (japaneast):
  - Require compliance checkbox for Japan-specific data residency guidance if private option is included.
  - Publish pricing as per Azure meter mapping; ensure meter IDs match pricing spreadsheet.
- GCP Seoul (asia-northeast-3):
  - GCP requires a public support email; use apac-support@redwood.com alias.
  - Ensure partner credit redemption writes to the Marketplace invoice metadata.

Acceptance test matrix (sample rows as checklist):
- Copy approved by partner comms (yes) — reviewer: partner rep name (checkpoint).
- JP translation signoff (yes/no) — reviewer: Hana Kim.
- Billing coupon redemption test (pass) — ticket: BILL-APAC-01.
- Marketplace listing goes live in staging and tile appears (pass) — ticket: MKT-LIST-APAC-02.
- Support routing test (alerts go to apac-support alias) — ticket: SRE-APAC-03.

Launch timeline (3-week fast path):
- Week 0: Kickoff & partner alignment (copy, credit amount); create billing SKU.
- Week 1: Localization pass + engineering tests for coupon redemption and ledger entries.
- Week 2: Marketplace staging publish, legal / tax stamp, and final partner signoff.
- Week 3: Go-live and 7-day monitoring window for abnormal refunds/redemptions.

Rolling back and revoking credits (emergency flow):
- Trigger conditions: mass abuse detected, incorrect coupon mapping, legal/regulatory stop request.
- Steps:
  1) Disable coupon in billing system (Priya).
  2) Notify marketplace partner manager and request listing pause.
  3) Issue internal incident ticket and inform partner operations channel.
  4) Run forensic report on redemptions and apply claw-back / manual billing corrections if required (legal consult).

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Decide whether to show "partner credit amount" on public tile or require click-through to view the offer details. (ops implication: showing amount increases support volume)
- FX policy for fixed-dollar credits: freeze FX at launch date vs daily FX conversion. (billing impact)
- Partner whitelist enforcement for pilot phase — who provides the canonical partner rep list?

Appendix: quick links and artifacts to prepare before launch:
- Pricing spreadsheet (shared): link to CONFLUENCE-3247 pricing table (ensure local currency column present).
- Billing test cases: BILL-APAC-01..05 (create test run tickets).
- Localization glossary: supply partner names and trademarks in JP/KO to localization team.

Next steps (owner tasks):
- Asha: confirm partner credit amount and partner contact by EOD Thu.
- Miguel: create billing SKU and draft redemption test ticket by end of week.
- Hana: complete headline translation + human signoff for JP/KO by next Wed.
- Priya: prepare tax note language and GST handling matrix for JP/KR/SG/AU.

Notes to reviewers: this is intentionally lightweight — we want something launchable and auditable. Feedback welcome on partner credit archetypes, translation quality expectations, and whether the FX policy should be a hard requirement for all APAC launches.

Draft history:
- 2025-02-10: initial outline and stakeholder list (Asha)
- 2025-02-18: added copy snippets and APAC marketplace notes (Hana, Miguel)
- 2025-03-12: updated billing SKU format and rollback flow (Priya)

End of doc.
